provenance: Per-family models of the training-set size ablation (cosine schedule, 100k steps), evaluated with the settings of scripts/size_sweep.py (seed 0, per-family budgets, LOOSE validity). The models for N = 40000 are available through scripts/download.py --size_sweep and re-evaluate with scripts/size_sweep.py eval --model per_family --sizes 40000. Re-evaluated on another GPU, the N = 40000 mean errors agree with these values within 1.2 % for the UR5 and within 7.3 % for the Franka, where five of the seven cells average over only 320 samples.
